value.rationale: Pareto-front cardinality and dominated hypervolume are two canonical but distinct quality measures in multiobjective sampling. Their exact joint dependence and persistent limiting negative correlation quantify a natural tradeoff and calibrate the information in a cardinality-only summary. Marginal count or mean hypervolume laws do not answer this question. The finite formula and sharp asymptotic constant are mathematically motivated, not arbitrary recomputations.
